collection_method: Load and validate the exact frozen query pack and protocol before collection.
Use immutable source-capture manifests and exact bounded excerpt artifacts; never treat a response status or page title as claim support.
Create exactly one inspection for every frozen entity-field slot.
A proven or conflicted observation must bind an exact UTF-8 excerpt byte span and matching supporting text.
Use does_not_establish when inspected captured material does not support a typed observation; cited sources and locators may document the unsuccessful inspection.
Treat every collector result as collector_proposed unless a synthetic fixture gate or separately bound operator decision verifies it.
source_priority: official product, pricing, or integration documentation
explicitly allowed independent evidence when the query pack permits it
